description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402] Bring columns from one table into another by a shared key (customer id, email, SKU), exactly: how "left" keeps every left row (blank when no match), "inner" keeps matches only, "anti" lists left rows with no match. Keys (up to 3 columns) match exactly, ignoring case, or as numbers ("00123" equals "123"). When the right table has the key more than once, take the first (like VLOOKUP) or all matches; duplicates are reported either way. Returns the joined rows plus counts of matched and unmatched rows on both sides. Up to 10000 rows per table.

columns.description: right-side columns to bring in (default all except the keys)

duplicates.description: right-side keys that repeat: first match (default, like VLOOKUP) or every match

match.description: how keys compare; default exact (after trimming spaces)

name: table_join
title: Join two tables on a key (VLOOKUP done exactly)
